# Critical-Path Coverage and Security Remediation Plan

**Prepared:** 2026-08-21  
**Evidence base:** `audit_artifacts/locked_full_coverage.xml`, generated by the locked PostgreSQL/PostGIS CI run that completed with 684 passed and 2 skipped tests.  
**Objective:** Raise the defined mission-critical code path from **57.33%** to at least **85%** statement coverage, while closing the remaining code and verification gaps from the 78/100 code-only assessment.

> **Coverage is a regression signal, not a security or correctness certificate.** The 85% target below applies only to a defined, risk-weighted module set. It must be coupled with negative authorization tests, mutation testing for financial controls, and environment-specific integration evidence.

## 2. Defined 85% Critical-Path Target

The selected critical module set comprises identity/authorization, financial transfer controls, oil-spill analysis/governance, PostgreSQL persistence, WALDO/Molmo service boundaries, and GeoDB tenant-scoped storage. It contains **4,078 measured statements**, of which **2,338** are currently covered (**57.33%**). Reaching 85% requires at least **3,467** covered statements: a net increase of **1,129** statements, assuming the measured source set does not materially change.

## 3. Exact Critical Test Cases

All tests below should use deterministic generated identifiers, PostgreSQL schemas/databases created for the test, and no live external service or real model download. Fake service responses are acceptable only at the process boundary; business decisions, authorization state, and database writes must use real application code.

| ID | Test case | Fixture and action | Required assertion |
|---|---|---|---|
| AUTH-01 | Expired, wrong issuer, wrong audience, and malformed OIDC token | JWKS test server; issue each invalid token | Every request is `401`; no database session or OPA call occurs. |
| AUTH-02 | Unknown JWT key rotation | JWKS server returns old key then refreshed key | One refresh succeeds for the new trusted key; unknown replacement remains `401`. |
| AUTH-03 | Claim stripping and MFA assurance | Token variants omit role, project, `amr`, or required ACR | Missing privilege/MFA cannot become an inferred privilege. |
| AUTH-04 | OPA timeout and malformed decision | Local OPA stub returns timeout, 500, invalid JSON, and `allow: true/false` | Protected request is denied on every malformed/unavailable decision. |
| AUTH-05 | Project BOLA matrix | Two organizations/projects; call every GET/PATCH/DELETE/list/statistics route as both users | Cross-tenant object access is `403/404`; same tenant succeeds; response contains no sibling data. |
| AUTH-06 | Mass-assignment rejection | Submit `owner_id`, role, audit fields, and foreign `project_id` with user/project/sample/drillhole payloads | Pydantic/API deny or ignore policy; persisted values remain server-controlled. |
| AUTH-07 | Transaction rollback | Force a downstream validation/integrity error during bulk sample/drillhole write | No partial parent/child state remains after error. |
| OIL-01 | Model artifact provenance | Use missing path, symlink outside allowed root, wrong hash, unsupported extension, invalid ONNX graph | Raw image inference fails closed before model execution. |
| OIL-02 | Registry lifecycle | Candidate, retired, hash-mismatched, and approval-revoked model records | Endpoint denies non-approved artifacts and audits the attempt. |
| OIL-03 | Inference output validation | Stub valid ONNX runtime with malformed shape, NaN/Inf, non-binary segmentation dimensions, empty result | Deterministic validation error; no incident persisted on invalid output. |
| OIL-04 | Geometry and GSD bounds | Masks touching edges, holes, tiny components, invalid GSD, antimeridian-like bounds | Valid GeoJSON only; area/severity remains bounded; invalid coordinate input fails. |
| OIL-05 | Review/coverage/export RBAC | Seed incident and test reviewer, approver, observer roles with/without MFA | Only policy-authorized role/MFA combination can review or approve; exports are audited. |
| OIL-06 | Temporal consensus | Aligned masks with real embeddings, missing embeddings, dimension mismatch, outlier frame | Real embedding similarity influences weights; fallback flag exists only for absent embeddings. |
| FIN-01 | Idempotent replay race | Two concurrent requests with same business key and same payload | One durable intent/transfer effect; both callers receive identical receipt. |
| FIN-02 | Idempotency conflict | Reuse same key with modified amount, currency, beneficiary, or metadata | Conflict response; no second intent/event. |
| FIN-03 | Maker-checker separation | Maker attempts approve/release; same checker approves twice; checker with no MFA | All actions denied and audit event records denied action. |
| FIN-04 | High-value quorum | Values below/above threshold and approvals from two distinct MFA-authenticated users | High value remains pending until distinct required approvals; only distinct releaser executes. |
| FIN-05 | Audit-chain tamper matrix | Modify event payload, sequence, predecessor hash, HMAC, or remove one event in copied schema | Verifier exits nonzero and reports first defective event. |
| FIN-06 | Database/retry recovery | Crash after idempotency reservation; retry after simulated TigerBeetle timeout | Reservation/receipt state resolves without duplicate transfer. |
| DATA-01 | Migration fresh/upgrade/downgrade | Dedicated PostgreSQL database, head migration, downgrade base, re-upgrade | Schema, constraints, indexes, and Alembic version are correct after each transition. |
| DATA-02 | Project-scoped GeoDB index/export | Seed two projects and run index/sync with each scope and no scope | Scoped outputs contain only the requested project; no-scope behavior is explicitly documented. |
| DATA-03 | Database failover behavior | Connection refusal, serialization failure, unique violation, closed session | API maps expected failures to safe errors; session rollback/close occurs. |
| WALDO-01 | Private service authentication | Missing, malformed, incorrect, and correct service tokens | Only valid private service token reaches detector; errors do not reveal internals. |
| WALDO-02 | File and request limits | Oversized body, unsupported MIME, corrupt image, decompression bomb header, multipart/JSON mismatch | Request rejected before heavy decode; no persistent temp file. |
| WALDO-03 | SSRF and remote-input refusal | Internal IP URL, file URL, redirect URL, unsupported scheme | URL ingestion route remains disabled/fail-closed. |
| WALDO-04 | Job-store isolation | Async disabled/enabled, invalid job ID, traversal attempt, expiry, cleanup race | No path traversal, deterministic 404/403, expired jobs cannot be retrieved. |
| WALDO-05 | Proxy timeout/retry | Simulated timeout, 429, malformed JSON, valid response | Bounded retry only where safe; no unbounded request amplification. |

## 4. CI Gates for the 85% Target

| Gate | Command or implementation | Promotion condition |
|---|---|---|
| Critical-module coverage | Add `.coveragerc` source include for the 20 selected files, then run `pytest tests/critical --cov=<critical modules> --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=85` | 85% branch coverage and 85% statement coverage; no test skip without an approved marker reason. |
| Whole-code ratchet | Continue `COVERAGE_MINIMUM=35 bash scripts/ci_full_test.sh` | Raise from 35% in five-point increments after two green protected-branch runs. |
| Mutation test | `mutmut`/`cosmic-ray` focused on `authz.py`, `security/opa.py`, `oil_spill/governance.py`, and `tigerbeetle_ledger.py` | Mutations that remove denies, idempotency checks, HMAC verification, or approval separation must be killed. |
| Contract test | Run OIDC/JWKS, OPA, WALDO, and PostGIS stubs in ephemeral Compose services | All negative security cases pass without a live cloud dependency. |
| Release test evidence | Store JUnit, coverage XML, SBOM, dependency scan, and signed provenance as CI artifacts | Protected-branch policy blocks release on missing/failed evidence. |

## 5. Security Vulnerability Remediation Plan

The security plan maps the discovered residual gaps to OWASP ASVS and OWASP API Security verification themes. ASVS is intended as a basis for testing application technical security controls, while the API Security project specifically identifies object-level authorization, authentication, resource consumption, sensitive business flows, SSRF, configuration, inventory, and unsafe third-party API consumption as API risks. [1] [2] NIST SSDF further recommends incorporating secure development practices into the delivery lifecycle to reduce vulnerabilities and limit the impact of those that remain. [3]

| Priority | Gap / threat | Remediation | Code and test deliverable | Verification gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | Identity/authorization modules are only 29.54% covered overall; tenant checks were recently remediated. | Enforce the AUTH-01 through AUTH-07 tests; add default-deny route inventory and property tests for all resource-ID routes. | `tests/critical/test_*authorization*.py`; generated route-to-policy manifest. | BOLA/BFLA negative matrix passes for every protected endpoint. |
| P0 | Financial transfer controls are internal only and not ready to move regulated value. | Keep transfer endpoints absent/disabled until independent payment service applies trusted OPA facts, durable idempotency, maker-checker, external immutable audit export, reconciliation, limits, KYC/AML/sanctions, and fraud decisions. | FIN-01 through FIN-06 tests; integration contract with payment provider. | Independent review and reconciliation proof; no public route before approval. |
| P0 | OPA policy package for high-value financial actions is not wired to a public payments service. | If a payments service is introduced, pass only server-derived intent/approval facts to OPA; fail closed on unavailable or malformed policy decisions. | Process-boundary OPA contract test; denied-decision audit test. | Timeout/malformed/missing-MFA/maker-self-approval cases denied. |
| P0 | Model and raw imagery ingress remain high-impact operational surfaces. | Complete OIL-01–04 and WALDO-01–05; enforce artifact allow-root, hash, size/MIME/decompression protections, timeouts, quotas, and audited rejection. | New endpoint/model/proxy tests; fuzz corpus for malformed media. | All malicious-input corpus cases fail before inference/storage. |
| P1 | Dependency scanning previously identified sandbox advisories; lock files now exist but release SBOM and scan policy need enforced CI publication. | Publish CycloneDX SBOM, run locked dependency scan on every PR, define severity/SLA exceptions with expiry, and pin base/container artifacts by digest. | CI workflow (requires workflow-authorized token) and signed artifacts. | No unresolved critical advisory; high advisory exception requires owner/expiry. |
| P1 | Broad untested specialist modules can hide unsafe default behavior. | Mark unsupported modules feature-gated; add deterministic fixtures for deployed paths and fail closed when optional dependency/model/service is absent. | Test suites for sensor fusion, external integrations, prospectivity, and climate modules. | Deployed-feature inventory has 85% critical-path coverage. |
| P1 | Audit records are database-resident and not independently immutable. | Export signed/chain-verified events to a segregated retention-controlled SIEM/evidence store; monitor chain verification failure. | Read-only exporter/CDC process and FIN-05 scheduled verification. | Restore/replay and tamper-alert drill succeeds. |
| P2 | Coverage only measures executed Python lines, not client UI, container, policy runtime, or real model behavior. | Add PWA/mobile tests, container image scanning, OPA/Rego runtime tests, controlled model contract suites, and environment-specific smoke tests. | Separate web/mobile and deployment quality gates. | Release checklist includes all delivery artifacts. |

## 6. Sequencing and Ownership

| Delivery increment | Scope | Exit evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Increment A — P0 authorization and financial | AUTH-01–07, FIN-01–06, OPA failure behavior | 85% coverage for identity and financial selected files; mutation tests kill control-removal mutations. |
| Increment B — P0 imagery and oil-spill ingress | OIL-01–06, WALDO-01–05 | 85% coverage for oil-spill/WALDO selected files; fuzz corpus report. |
| Increment C — P1 data integrity and supply chain | DATA-01–03, SBOM/scan/release artifacts | 85% coverage for data persistence selected files; migration and dependency evidence. |
| Increment D — P1 specialist deployed modules | Sensor/integration/model contracts actually enabled in production | Every enabled feature has defined owner, threat model, contract tests, and coverage threshold. |
